## User need

Who needs this, and what are they trying to accomplish?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful change.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable behavior is specified.
- [ ] Failure and recovery behavior are described.
- [ ] Relevant tests are identified.

## Alternatives and trade-offs

Describe alternatives considered and important constraints.
